headline: Banco Santander Chile Agrees Collective Labor Agreement with Unions
summary: Banco Santander Chile concluded a collective bargaining deal providing end-of-conflict bonuses up to 13.5 million pesos and establishing a minimum salary of 1.3 million pesos for workers.
why: Santander Chile is the largest commercial bank in Chile; collective wage terms influence operating costs and sector compensation benchmarks.

impacts.name: Banco Santander Chile
impacts.why: Finalized comprehensive union contract locking in salary floors and bonus outlays.
